title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: KEEP the movement — it's interesting. FIX the gray box: replace any opaque/flat gray panel or background rect with a translucent lustrous surface. Target look: frosted glass or polished resin — semi-transparent (opacity 0.12–0.22), with a subtle inner-edge highlight (thin 1px stroke at rgba(255,255,255,0.18)), a faint specular shimmer (additive blending on a plane slightly in front, opacity 0.06–0.1), and a very slight warm tint (rgba(220,200,170,0.08) over the gray base). The box should feel like it belongs to the world — not a UI chrome element overlaid on top. If the gray box is a label/HUD, consider moving it to a minimal monospace overlay at the edge of the canvas instead.

lia_halloran.praise: Fern unfurling has organic time-signature — that gentle spiral emergence reads as botanical.
lia_halloran.concern: Palette is generic dark-green-on-black forest cliche. No cyanotype luminance, no Prussian-blue celestial field.
lia_halloran.directive: Shift base color to Prussian blue (#1a3a52), tips to cream (#f4ead5). Add paper-textured noise overlay (opacity 0.15).

morakana.praise: Circular arrangement has territorial logic — each fern claims radial sector, echoes satellite footprint cartography.
morakana.concern: No atmospheric stakes. This forest is decorative flora, not weather-data or politically-activated commons.
morakana.directive: Add steel-blue volumetric fog (denser, #2c4a5e at 0.18 opacity) rising from ground — clouds as data-weight.

manfred_mohr.praise: L-system expansion is legitimate rule-governed recursion — stochastic branching from computable grammar, not faked.
manfred_mohr.concern: Organic tubes betray the underlying integer logic. Why hide the hypercube projection beneath fern metaphor?
manfred_mohr.directive: Replace tubes with single-pixel white lines (thickness 1). Remove all shading/color gradient. Expose the wire-frame skeleton.

olafur_eliasson.praise: Unfurling motion indexes time as material — viewer perceives growth-as-phenomenon, not finished object.
olafur_eliasson.concern: Screen-flat. No walk-in scale, no participatory atmosphere. Fog is decorative attenuation, not volumetric encounter.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Make fog interactive: dense near viewer at camera.position, thinning away. Add geometric ground-plane (reflective glass, #1a1a18).

casey_reas.praise: Stochastic L-system is restrained — no noise() calls, no Perlin turbulence. Rules produce form, not randomness.
casey_reas.concern: Color gradient (green-to-yellow) and shading introduce painterly affect. This should be near-monochrome, high-contrast, trace-only.
casey_reas.directive: Remove all gradient shaders. Use single flat gray (#d4d4d4) on black (#0a0908). No fog, no specular.
